nodes.text: You sat through my talk of edges without changing the subject to fishing, so you can have the rest of it. Frostfall is a month off, and the shallows fringed this morning. Forty years I have watched the edges and they have never once been early. Go and ask Odd about his newest row. Tell him the water sent you.

choices.text: Why me and not the reeve?
Ice comes early some years. That is all.

nodes.text: Because if I walk into the yard with one fisher's worry, Halla files it under one fisher. Four people have each noticed one true thing this season, and a stranger can carry all four without the town watching the carrying. Then it is not worry. It is a count.
Odd first, at the nursery. Then wherever he points you, and he will point. When you have all four, take them to Halla and only Halla. The inn hears everything a beat too early in this town.
Then forget I spoke. The lake will tell everyone eventually. It is just politer, hearing it from a fisher first.
